status: Source-backed inputs with explicit ERP and beta-method caveats; illustrative CAPM only, not independently verified WACC.

risk_free.definition: US Treasury 10-year par constant-maturity yield; indicative bid-side quotations near 3:30 PM, not transaction yield

erp.method: Damodaran trailing 12-month adjusted payout implied ERP
erp.caveat: Home page says underlying US Treasury rate 5.29% and US default spread 0.22%. Treasury October 30 10Y is 4.94%; 5.29% matches September 30. Unresolved page/input-date inconsistency; do not silently relabel this a fully matched November 6 calibration. Monthly spreadsheet could not be read by web tool (unsupported xlsx content type).

beta.status: Observed vendor statistic, not independently estimated
beta.frequency: Monthly per Yahoo indexed search result; StockAnalysis labels only 5Y
beta.caveat: Yahoo search result fetched November 7 shows Beta (5Y monthly) 1.30, but direct page fetch returned HTTP 429. Exact regression dates, benchmark, raw/adjusted methodology and dividend treatment not verified. Do not invent them.

crosscheck.method_caveat: Table explicitly describes daily benchmark returns for up/down beta only; full standard-beta method not verified.

illustrative_cost_equity.label: Illustrative mixed-date CAPM using 4.86% Treasury, observed vendor beta 1.30 and dated, caveated ERP proxy 4.41%
illustrative_cost_equity.sensitivity_caveat: Low/high are analyst-selected assumptions, not observed confidence interval or forecast.

capital_weights.share_class_note: Class B convertible one-for-one into Class A. Applying Class A price to both classes is explicit economic valuation convention.
capital_weights.caveat: Share date, price date and debt date differ. Debt weights here exclude leases; parent author separately handles finance leases. Do not use Class A shares alone; do not subtract cash from financing weights.

debt_cost.status: Unknown; no verified November 6 traded yield or credit spread. Coupon is not current marginal cost.
debt_cost.hedge_comment: 10Q discloses $800m net investment hedge notional and fixed/fixed cross-currency swaps economically converting some USD notes to euro obligations. Exact swap coupon rates not found in reviewed 10Q. Do not substitute historic hedged euro coupon for USD discount-rate marginal debt cost.
debt_cost.borrowings: No commercial paper, Global Credit Facility or Pan-Asia facility borrowings at September 26, 2026.

wacc.reason: ERP-date mismatch, exact beta regression methods, marginal debt yield and final lease-consistent financing weights are not all verified. Around 10.3% can be an explicit modeling assumption, not a sourced observed WACC.
